records.claim: The Skilled Work Experience SMC pathway requires a job or job offer in an ANZSCO skill level 1 to 3 occupation, pay of at least 1.1 times the SMC wage threshold, at least 3 years of relevant work experience, and an additional 2 years of skilled work experience in New Zealand. Amber-list roles have higher requirements and red-list roles cannot use this pathway; self-employment cannot count as relevant work experience.
records.methodology: Direct review of current SMC pathway guidance; evidence is limited to the Skilled Work Experience child route.

records.claim: The Skilled Work Experience pathway requires pay of at least 1.1 times the applicable SMC wage threshold, with higher wage treatment for applicable amber-list occupations. The applicable wage threshold is effective-date dependent.
records.methodology: Direct review of current official wage-rate guidance; no separate proof-of-funds requirement is inferred.

records.claim: Applicants use the SMC residence process and must provide evidence of their employment, work history, pay and other claimed eligibility. The selected pathway must match the pathway for which the applicant is invited to apply.
records.methodology: Direct review of current SMC application evidence guidance.

records.claim: The Trades and Technician SMC pathway requires an eligible trades or technician role, a relevant qualification and at least 4 years of post-qualification work experience including at least 18 months of skilled work experience in New Zealand. Additional occupation and qualification rules apply.
records.methodology: Direct review of current SMC pathway guidance; evidence is limited to the Trades and Technician child route.

records.claim: The Trades and Technician pathway uses the applicable SMC wage threshold for skilled employment, with pathway-specific wage and occupation settings. Current official wage guidance provides the effective threshold and multiplier rules that apply to the pathway.
records.methodology: Direct review of current official wage-rate guidance; no separate proof-of-funds requirement is inferred.

records.claim: Applicants must evidence the eligible occupation, qualification and post-qualification work experience claimed under the Trades and Technician pathway, using the SMC residence application process and applicable qualification assessment rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current SMC application evidence guidance and final 2026 pathway changes.
